channel.title: CyberVault
channel.description: Cybersecurity blog covering penetration testing, DFIR, malware analysis, reverse engineering, and threat intelligence by v!R_3pH0$ from Sri Lanka.

item.title: Zero-Auth to Root: Weaponizing Embedded CGI Command Injection into Telnet Auth Bypass
item.description: A hands-on walkthrough demonstrating how I discovered an unauthenticated command injection in an embedded IOT Device web management interface, chained shell commands to bypass execution filters, and hijacked the device's Telnet service without a password.
item.dc:creator: v!R_3pH0$

item.title: Operation SILVER_SPECTRE Unveiled: Diamond Model Profiling & Threat Infrastructure Pivoting
item.description: Profiling an Advanced Persistent Threat (APT) group using the Diamond Model, MITRE ATT&CK mapping, infrastructure pivoting via passive DNS and JARM TLS fingerprinting, and Sigma detection engineering.
item.dc:creator: v!R_3pH0$

item.title: Dissecting the 'dark_node' Implant: Reverse Engineering Stripped ELF C2 Wire Protocols with Ghidra
item.description: Deep-dive reverse engineering of a stripped ELF adversary C2 implant. Reconstructing custom binary communication protocols, command dispatch tables, and developing an offline protocol emulator.
item.dc:creator: v!R_3pH0$

item.title: Inside an Evasive Loader: From PE Entropy & Anti-Debugging to Manual Unpacking & YARA
item.description: Unpacking and analyzing a real-world multi-stage loader. From PE header triage and anti-analysis evasion bypasses to manual payload extraction and writing YARA detection rules.
item.dc:creator: v!R_3pH0$

item.title: Zero Disk Footprint: Unmasking In-Memory Malware & Process Hollowing with Volatility 3
item.description: A step-by-step incident response investigation dissecting memory dumps using Volatility 3, hunting process injection (process hollowing / reflective DLL), and building a timeline of compromise.
item.dc:creator: v!R_3pH0$

item.title: The WAF Evasion Playbook: From Fingerprinting to Request Smuggling & Polyglot Bypasses
item.description: Explore the cat-and-mouse game between attackers and Web Application Firewalls. Learn encoding tricks, HTTP request smuggling, header manipulation, and polyglot payloads that slip past commercial WAF solutions.
item.dc:creator: v!R_3pH0$

item.title: The Root Hunter's Field Manual: Chaining SUID, Sudo & Kernel Misconfigurations in Linux
item.description: Master the art of Linux privilege escalation. Covering SUID/SGID abuse, sudo misconfigurations, cron job exploitation, writable paths, kernel exploits and more — with practical commands and real-world examples.
item.dc:creator: v!R_3pH0$

item.title: Dissecting Modern SQLi: From Union & Error Extraction to Blind Out-of-Band Exfiltration
item.description: An in-depth exploration of SQL injection vulnerabilities — from classic union-based attacks to blind time-based extraction. Includes real payloads, detection bypasses, and hardening your applications against SQLi.
item.dc:creator: v!R_3pH0$

item.title: The Ethical Hacker's Blueprint: Scoping, RoE Frameworks & 5-Phase Penetration Testing
item.description: Learn the fundamentals of penetration testing, from reconnaissance to reporting. This comprehensive guide covers the essential phases of an ethical hacking engagement and the mindset required to succeed.
item.dc:creator: v!R_3pH0$
